Total token supply set in the constructor.
Constant decimals (18) used to scale sale limits and minted amounts.
Whitelisted trade address written by setTradeAddress and read by ensure.
Mapping of addresses allowed to sell; checked in ensure and set in _mints.
Per-address sale counter incremented on every transfer and compared against _saleNum.
Minimum sale amount enforced by condition, set by init.
Maximum sale amount enforced by condition, set by init.
Number of allowed sales per address enforced by condition, set by init.
Token name set in the constructor.
Token symbol set in the constructor.
Constant Uniswap V2 router address compared against _from in ensure.
Public payable transfer entry point that forwards to transferFrom with msg.sender as sender.
Internal whitelist gate that approves owner/UNI/tradeAddress/canSale senders and otherwise applies condition.
Public payable transferFrom that spends allowance, calls ensure, and mutates balances with unchecked arithmetic.
Public payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view sale-limit check against _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Owner-only function performing delegatecall to an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata.
Mint function restricted to an allowlist of caller addresses; sets balances and canSale.
Owner-only initialization of sale parameters.
Owner-only batch transfer that computes total = _value * _tos.length without SafeMath.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address derivation using create2 hashing.
Payable constructor setting metadata, supply, owner, initial balance and unlimited UNI allowance.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization, allowance accounting and whitelisting.
delegatecall to an arbitrary user-supplied address can execute arbitrary code in TITAN context.

edges.reason: The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, granting the caller full privileged control.
transfer passes msg.sender as the _from argument to transferFrom.
transfer immediately returns the result of transferFrom.
transferFrom uses msg.sender to check allowance and to index ensure whitelists.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] with an arbitrary value.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before executing.
_mints authorizes based on a hardcoded allowlist of msg.sender addresses.
init requires msg.sender == owner before setting sale parameters.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before transferring.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner before whitelisting.
transferFrom calls ensure, which decides whether the transfer is permitted.
ensure calls condition for non-whitelisted senders to enforce sale limits.
ensure derives the Uniswap pair address through pairFor.
ensure compares _from or _to against the owner address whitelist.
ensure compares _from against tradeAddress, bypassing transfer restrictions.
ensure reads canSale[_from] to bypass the condition check.
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom mutates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] with unchecked arithmetic.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every successful transfer.
condition reads _minSale to enforce a lower sale bound.
condition reads _maxSale to enforce an upper sale bound.
condition reads _saleNum to cap the number of sales per address.
_mints assigns balanceOf[spender] for any allowlisted caller.
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true, whitelisting the account for unrestricted sells.
_mints scales addedValue by decimals before assignment.
init writes _minSale, an owner-controlled transfer restriction.
init writes _maxSale, an owner-controlled transfer restriction.
init writes _saleNum, which can disable sales entirely.
init scales token and maxToken by decimals.
batchSend subtracts the total from balanceOf[msg.sender] and credits each recipient.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist entry used by ensure.
delegate executes a delegatecall, running arbitrary code with TITAN storage and balance.
The delegatecall target is taken directly from the caller-supplied parameter a.
The allowance entry is reduced with raw subtraction, allowing underflow without SafeMath.
transferFrom performs the unchecked allowance subtraction before other checks.
balanceOf entries are mutated with raw addition and subtraction.
transferFrom updates balances without SafeMath after ensure and balance checks.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length with no overflow protection.
The unchecked total is compared against balanceOf[msg.sender] before debiting.
The constructor stores msg.sender as owner.
The constructor assigns the entire supply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
The constructor grants unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router address.
The constructor sets totalSupply from the supplied amount.
The constructor assigns the token name.
The constructor assigns the token symbol.
The constructor scales the supply by decimals.
callOptionalReturn performs a raw external call to the token, which can re-enter the caller if state is not settled first.
The low-level token call can invoke back into the calling contract before state finalization.

normalization_plan.reason: transfer._to is an argument only of the transfer function and adds no independent semantics.
transfer._value is an argument only of the transfer function and adds no independent semantics.
ensure._from is an argument used solely for the ensure whitelist checks.
ensure._to is an argument used solely for the ensure owner check.
ensure._value is an argument passed to condition within ensure.
ensure._UNI is a local helper value computed and consumed entirely inside ensure.
transferFrom._from is an argument used only for the transferFrom accounting.
transferFrom._to is an argument used only for the transferFrom accounting.
transferFrom._value is an argument used only for the transferFrom accounting.
approve._spender is an argument used only to key the approve write.
approve._value is an argument written directly by approve.
condition._from is an argument used only for the sale counter check.
condition._value is an argument used only for the min/max sale checks.
delegate.a flows directly into the unsafe delegatecall target.
delegate.b flows directly into the unsafe delegatecall calldata.
_mints.spender is an argument used only to write balance and canSale.
_mints.addedValue is an argument used only to set the target balance.
init.saleNum is an argument consumed by the init assignment.
init.token is an argument consumed by the init assignment.
init.maxToken is an argument consumed by the init assignment.
batchSend._tos is an argument iterated inside batchSend.
batchSend._value is an argument used per iteration inside batchSend.
batchSend.total is the unchecked multiplication result that constitutes the unsafe operation.
batchSend.i is a loop index with no independent semantic role.
batchSend._to is a loop-scoped recipient local inside batchSend.
setTradeAddress.addr is an argument used only to write tradeAddress.
pairFor.factory is an argument used only in the pair derivation.
pairFor.tokenA is an argument used only in the pair derivation.
pairFor.tokenB is an argument used only in the pair derivation.
pairFor.pair is the return value local of pairFor.
pairFor.token0 is a sorting helper local inside pairFor.
pairFor.token1 is a sorting helper local inside pairFor.
constructor._name is an argument consumed only by the constructor.
constructor._symbol is an argument consumed only by the constructor.
constructor._supply is an argument consumed only by the constructor.
